turn.subject: sizing
turn.user_message: Consultants finish rounds by about 11. The RMO drafts the summary, the consultant signs, and a transcriptionist types it up. We’re 250 beds, around 88% full, 40–45 discharges a day.

text: Thank you — that’s the first stop done. Three people handle every summary, and none of it starts before 11.
To put a price on the wait, I need two numbers: what one bed earns in a day, and how long a patient waits to leave once they’re ready.
chat.pointer: Type your two numbers into the empty boxes and the sums fill themselves.
chat.note: A delay only moves people once it has a price.
